Intro: on mid-sized data without strong regularization ViT is a few points below comparable ResNets; conclusion lists three open challenges (detection/segmentation, self-supervision gap, further scaling)
Masked patch prediction: 50% corrupted with 80/10/10 split, setup described as very similar to BERT; self-supervised model trained on JFT ~14 epochs; ViT-B/16 79.9% ImageNet
Attention Rollout averages heads of ViT-L/16 and recursively multiplies attention matrices of all layers
